description: Fleet-wide Slurm workload accounting from the tray-side cgroup exporter. Canonical owner of job counts, per-job/per-tray/per-user allocation and cgroup-exporter coverage. GPU faults are owned by GPU Health, tray availability by Executive, host pressure by Node Deep Dive.

options.content:
Jobs & Cluster — area home

Workload accounting for IREN_MKZ comes from the Slurm cgroup exporter on every tray (cgroup_info, cgroup_memory_*, cgroup_cpu_*) — a job appears here as soon as its cgroup exists on a tray. Counts labelled “in range” cover the dashboard time range; the rest are the latest scrape. Every tile is backed by the table beneath it: the tile is that table's row count, or the total in its footer. Fleet GPU faults live on GPU Health, host and tray availability on Executive and Node Deep Dive. Silent means no sample for over five minutes, measured from the last sample timestamp — not up==0, which never fires here because a dead tray loses its scrape target instead of reporting zero.
